messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to video 0 and make the following change to that video: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands in the center of the frame, turning her body and head to look around the area while shifting her weight and posing with her hands on her hips.","camera":"The camera is at a medium distance, framing the woman from the shins up, and slowly moves closer and pans slightly to follow her movements.","clothing":"She wears a pink and white gingham corset-style top with white off-the-shoulder sleeves, a black leather-look skirt, and white sneakers.","hair_color":"Her hair is light brown.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into a high ponytail.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young woman with a slim build and tanned skin.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor amusement park at dusk, featuring a large Ferris wheel, a red and green ticket booth, and other carnival rides in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The urban rooftop background with buildings, cranes, and Japanese signage was replaced by an outdoor amusement park with a Ferris wheel, roller coaster, ticket booth, and arcade, matching the reference. The woman remains in the same pose sequence and similar framing, and the lighting now reflects the new dusk carnival environment.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the amusement park setting shown in the reference, placing the person there while retaining her identity, appearance, expression, action, and the existing camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the shoe color change is due to lighting or an unintended appearance change.
unexpected_changes: The woman's shoes appear white in the output instead of the blue sneakers visible in the source.
